page.overview:
Who is Kip Bunyea?

Kip Bunyea, or "The Kip," was a Human male from the planet Naboo with affiliations to data slicers and smugglers. A dead-or-alive bounty on him was posted by Aruk the Hutt no later than 32 BBY. That year, he spent time at the Outlander Club in the Uscru Entertainment District of the planet Coruscant during bounty hunter Jango Fett's pursuit of drug dealer Jervis Gloom.

Kip Bunyea, also known as "The Kip," was a Human male Naboo. He the Hutt criminal Aruk Besadii Aora had issued a bounty for him. It stated Bunyea's last known location was the Core Worlds and described him as extremely hateful and unruly. The bounty also offered a price of 2,000 credits for him alive or 1,000 for his death.

In 32 BBY, Bunyea spent time at the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. He stood at the club's bar when Mandalorian bounty hunter Jango Fett entered during his pursuit of death stick dealer Jervis Gloom. The man remained there while Fett threatened the bartender and dispatched several thugs.

Bunyea was identified as a bounty by Fett and was captured as he cowered pathetically at the bar.
